REGISTRATION OF CRIMINALS AND UNDESIRABLE
PERSONS ACT 1969

REGISTRATION OF CRIMINALS AND UNDESIRABLE
PERSONS (AMENDMENT) ORDER 1985

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 15 (1) of the
Registration of Criminals and Undesirable Persons Act 1969, the
Minister makes the following order:

1. This Order may be cited as the Registration of Criminals and
Undesirable Persons (Amendment) Order 1985.

2. (1) Part IV of the First Schedule (Sabah and Sarawak) and
Part VI of the First Schedule (States of Malaya) to the Registration
of Criminals and Undesirable Persons Act 1969 (hereinafter
referred to as "the Act") is amended by adding at the appropriate
place, the following items to the list of items:

No.                    Short Title                   Section
"Act 283... Drug Dependants (Treatment The Whole
and Rehabilitation) Act 1983
Act 234 ... Dangerous Drugs Act 1952... The Whole.".

(2) Part II of the First Schedule (Sarawak) to the Act is
amended by deleting the following item:
No.                     Short Title                    Section
"Cap. 119... Dangerous Drugs Ordinance 4, 5, 6, 9, 12,
1953                 13, 14, 17, 19,
20, 21, 22, 23
and 24".
